data.name: Eliakim
data.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew El (God) and yakim (raised up or built), Eliakim signifies God has raised up or God will build. In the Old Testament, Eliakim is the name of a high priest and a royal official.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying divine guidance and strength.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, creative, and artistic, threes are often, but not always, a joy to be around. They can be highly attractive and charming, able to persuade others effortlessly.

in_hebrew.name: אליקים
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים מקים ומחזק - אלוהים מקים ומשגיח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליקים הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים מקים ומחזק' או 'אלוהים מקים ומשגיח'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אלי' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ו'קים' שפירושו 'מקים' או 'מחזק'. השם אליקים מופיע בתנ'ך ככינויו של אחד מבניו של יהויקים, מלך יהודה.

in_greek.name: Ηλιάκιμ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός εγείρει και ενδυναμώνει - Ο Θεός εγείρει και φυλάττει
in_greek.long_meaning: Ηλιάκιμ είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος אליקים. Προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ἠλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και 'ἀκίμ' που σημαίνει 'εγείρει' ή 'ενδυναμώνει'. Το όνομα Ηλιάκιμ αναφέρεται στην Καινή Διαθήκη ως το όνομα ενός από τους υπηρέτες του βασιλιά Εζεκία.

in_latin.name: Eliakim
in_latin.meaning: Deus exsurgit et confortat - Deus exsurgit et regit
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eliakim derivatur ex hebraeo nomine אליקים, quod significat 'Deus exsurgit et confortat' vel 'Deus exsurgit et regit'. Nomen Eliakim inveniuntur in Biblia sacra, scilicet in libro Regum et in libro Isaiae, ubi Eliakim filius est regis Iehovaikim.

in_english.name: Eliakim
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eliakim originates from the Hebrew name אליקים (El'Yaqim), which means 'God raises' or 'God establishes'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' (אל), meaning 'God', and 'yaqim' (יקים), meaning 'raises' or 'establishes'. Eliakim appears in the Bible as the name of several individuals, including a king of Judah and a high-ranking official. The name has been adopted in various Christian traditions, symbolizing divine support and providence.

biblical_reference.note: Eliakim was a royal official during the reign of King Hezekiah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eliakim is rich in cultural heritage, with roots deeply entwined in ancient Jewish history. In biblical times, Eliakim was an influential figure who played significant roles in the Old Testament's narratives as a high priest and a royal official, representing strength and power.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Eliakim denotes trust and reliance in God's divine plan for an individual's life. It is a powerful reminder that even during times of trials and tribulations, one's faith and reverence for God will be the foundation upon which they can be built, raised up, and grow as a person. Just like God's inspiring presence in the life of Eliakim in the Bible, the name imparts confidence that God will always be present to help in moments of need.

historical_references.reference: Eliakim is mentioned as a high-ranking official in the Babylonian exile, bearing the title 'Overseer of the royal household'. He is given the name 'Gabriel' by the prophet Ezekiel as a sign of God's favor and renewed covenant.

Eliakim, also known as Shealtiel, is a descendant of King David and is the grand-father of the biblical character Zerubbabel. He is entrusted by the prophet Haggai with the task of leading the returned exiles in rebuilding the Second Temple in Jerusalem.
historical_references.context: Return from exile and rebuilding the Second Temple

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Eliakim continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Eliakim, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Eliakim meaning "God raised up" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Eliakim: God establishes or sets up. Symbolizes trust in God to establish and fulfill His promises.
